title: Cross-host native relay send reports durableButNotWoken even when the recipient is woken and replies
outcome: Cross-host native relay send reports durableButNotWoken even when the recipient is woken and replies
acceptance: A native relay send to a cross-host recipient whose wake is delivered reports a disposition that does not claim the recipient was not woken; when the wake outcome is not known at response time the disposition says unknown or pending rather than durableButNotWoken.
A focused regression covers a cross-host relay send whose recipient wake completes after the send response, and asserts the reported disposition is truthful.
